signals.summary: A steady swell of late-summer eating: peach/berry/melon bakes, tomato-and-corn salads, and breezy brie-and-produce plates as outlets publish end-of-season roundups.
signals.why_now: Multiple independent outlets within the past week: Washington Post's creamy-brie summer meals (~4d), Serious Eats' 'late-summer recipes before the season slips away' (~6d), and three separate Food & Wine roundups on summer fruit, vegetables and tomato-corn salads. Clearly seasonal for mid-August.

signals.topic: Fancy / gourmet hot dogs of summer
signals.summary: Elevated, maximalist hot dogs — caviar-topped 'glizzies' and haute franks — framed as summer's playful indulgence food.
signals.why_now: Two independent outlets inside 48h: Vogue's 'It's a Fancy Hot Dog Summer' (~48h) and Moneywise on the $100 caviar-topped 'Golden Glizzy' (~22h). A small but fresh wave.
